proposal.claim: Boosting ankle balance gain raises the corrective torque during stance, improving stability on seeds where ankle feedback is currently too weak.
Reducing knee phase shift shortens the delay between foot contact and knee flexion, helping the gait transition on seeds that stall due to delayed knee motion.
Increasing start_lean adds an initial forward pitch bias, giving the model a stronger forward push at footstrike and can unlock walking on more seeds.
Raising pitch_kp amplifies torso-pitch feedback, allowing quicker correction of pitch errors that currently cause falls on certain seeds.
